meta.previous: brand/design-system-v1/project/tokens.json (white first, Jost; the product web follows it until phase 3)

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page: warm ivory in light, warm charcoal in dark. Every page sits on it.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: A quiet band across the page (Inside the box), a notice, a card, the pressed language, the agent's own words in a held request.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: The layer that fades in under a row, a secondary button or a chip on hover. Between paper and band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text that matters, the primary button, the icons' strokes and the focus ring. 15.5:1 on paper (light), 15.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Running text: leads, descriptions, paragraphs. 9.3:1 / 10.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Warm grey: labels, dates, counts, notes, footer notes, placeholders. 5.5:1 / 6.6:1 on paper, never under 4.8:1 on any surface or wash.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Clay for text: links, a project's line under its title, a name on hover. 5.4:1 / 6.9:1 on paper. Sparingly: one clay thing per view is the norm.

tokens.name: clay-mark
tokens.usage: Clay for shapes only, never for text: the dot of the wordmark, the dot in each icon, the favicon, the progress state. 3.6:1 / 5.6:1 on paper (above the 3:1 for shapes).

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: A pale clay fill under an ink stroke (the moon, the approve disc, the top slab of backtide in Inside the box). Never behind text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and arrows on an ink fill (the primary button, the skip link). Always paper, never a literal white.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: The layer that fades in over the primary button on hover. on-ink stays 11:1 / 12:1 on it.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows of a list, inside a table, above the footer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Stronger rules: under a list's head, above a year, around a secondary button, the faint strokes of an icon.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The border of a field, a select, a switch or a checkbox: the edge of something you operate. 3.4:1 / 3.8:1 on paper (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text. Ink stays 11.7:1 / 8.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: state-preview
tokens.usage: Tide blue. A project shown as a preview (its dot in a ledger). 6.4:1 / 8.0:1, so it can also colour a word.

tokens.name: state-progress
tokens.usage: In progress: the clay mark, as a dot only. The word next to it stays in ink-soft.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: Sage. Done, works: its dot in a ledger. 5.6:1 / 8.5:1.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Tide blue: a notice that informs. Its icon and, if needed, its title.

tokens.name: info-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of an information notice.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Sage: something went well (approved, saved, rewound).

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of a success notice.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Ochre: look at this (a stale reading, a partial list, a key not in use).

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of a warning notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Crimson, pinker than clay so the two never read as one: an error, something that failed or cannot be used. 6.8:1 / 7.2:1.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of an error notice.

tokens.name: hold-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of a held request that waits for your yes, and of its notice. Clay, muted and ink all stay above 4.5:1 on it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: A project's name on its own page. Once per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The headline of the home page. Once per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The title of a document page.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: A section's heading on a public page (SectionHeader).

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: A logbook entry's name; the title of a page of the product web.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: A row's name in an index, a year, a rule's title, a section inside a product page.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.sample: Send an email to two people
styles.usage: A part's name, an agent's card, what a held request wants to do.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: A record kept by the agent is only as trustworthy as the agent.
styles.usage: One pull quote inside a long section. At most once per page.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: A black box for AI agents.
styles.usage: The line under a project's name, in clay. Once per page.

styles.name: aside
styles.sample: A black box for AI agents.
styles.usage: The line under a logbook entry's name, in ink-soft.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Small projects, made slowly in spare time.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline, in ink-soft, at most measure wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It records what the agent does, rewinds its working folder and holds back what cannot be undone.
styles.usage: Running text on public pages. 1rem on phones.

styles.name: body-ui
styles.usage: The denser text of the product web: rows, cards, fields, notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: A state's word, a list's head, a field's label, the navigation of the product web.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A fact's name (dt), a field's hint, a table's head, footnotes.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: A tag in a pill. Never a sentence.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths and hashes the product shows. From the system: no web font, nothing to load. Keeps "--" as two hyphens.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between the two language buttons; a dot and a tight word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: A state's icon and its word; a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a notice; between a field and its hint.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A notice's and a card's padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A card's padding; between a title and its lead; rows of a ledger.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading and the list it heads; actions under a lead.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups of fields; between entries of the logbook.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the parts of a product page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Before a list of facts; around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between the sections of a product page on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The smallest gap between the sections of a public page.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between the sections of a public page: 96 to 160 px. The air is the design.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The widest the content gets (1216 px), margins apart.

tokens.name: page-app
tokens.usage: The width of the product web's pages: denser, closer.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: The side margin: 20 px on a phone, 88 px on a wide screen.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: The gutter between columns.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest line of running text.

tokens.name: measure-narrow
tokens.usage: A description, a quote, a notice's text.

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.usage: At or below: side-by-side halves stack, the hero drawing moves under the text.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.usage: At or below: one column; every grid child spans all twelve; tables stack.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The focus ring's corners; small marks.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: The language buttons and their sliding indicator; chips' inner shapes.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: The hover layer under a row; a field; a select.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, primary and secondary.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: A notice, a card, a held request, the agent's words.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, count badges, the switch.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Dots: the wordmark's, a state's, a risk's.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Every rule (hair, line), a secondary button's border, a field's border.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Every icon stroke, at any size (vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke).

tokens.name: stroke-art
tokens.usage: Larger drawings (the hero's shore and curl).

tokens.name: stroke-arrow
tokens.usage: The small arrow in links and buttons.

tokens.name: stroke-slab
tokens.usage: The outlines of the slabs in Inside the box.

tokens.name: stroke-identity
tokens.usage: An agent's tag: a short rounded line in its colour before its name.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: The ring is always the full 2 px.

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: Ink in both themes: 14:1 or more on paper and on band.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between the element and the ring.

tokens.name: focus-offset-rest
tokens.usage: Where the ring starts: it closes in from 8 to 3 px as it appears.

tokens.name: focus-radius
tokens.usage: The ring's corners on text links; controls keep their own radius.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: The smallest tap target: small buttons, chips, the switch's label row.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: A button's height.

tokens.name: size-icon-s
tokens.usage: An icon beside a word (Status, Notice, Badge).

tokens.name: size-icon-m
tokens.usage: A project's icon in the logbook and on its page.

tokens.name: size-icon-l
tokens.usage: An icon above a section's heading.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: The drawing of an empty state.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: The wordmark's dot and a state's dot.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The default: arrivals, hovers, lifts. Fast out, long calm settle.

tokens.name: ease-reveal
tokens.usage: Reveal on scroll and page transitions.

tokens.name: ease-draw
tokens.usage: A long stroke drawing itself (the hero's curl).

tokens.name: ease-drop
tokens.usage: Something placed down (the slabs of Inside the box).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: The focus ring closing in.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover layers, the arrow's nudge.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: An underline drawing, a lift, the language indicator.

tokens.name: duration-icon
tokens.usage: An icon's own gesture on hover.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: A block rising into view.

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.usage: An icon's strokes drawing themselves; a rule growing.

tokens.name: duration-entrance
tokens.usage: The headline's entrance on load.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: A view transition between pages.

tokens.name: rise
tokens.usage: How far a block rises as it appears.

tokens.name: rise-entrance
tokens.usage: How far the headline rises, with an 8 px blur that clears.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: The delay between siblings appearing together; at most five steps.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: A slab lifted when you point at its description.

tokens.name: nudge
tokens.usage: An arrow's step on hover.

app.name: The product web
app.usage: Colour with meaning for backtide web (phase 3): who (identity), how serious (risk) and how the agent is (state). Paper, ink and clay stay the base, Lora and DM Sans the type. Every colour here is at least 4.5:1 on paper, band and its own wash, in both themes, so it can colour a word; and it is never the only signal: an identity sits next to the agent's name, a risk is also a dot's shape and a word, a state is always written.

tokens.name: agent-1
tokens.usage: Tide blue. The agent in place 1 of the list: its tag, its card's line, its name in the feed.

tokens.name: agent-1-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-1's card.

tokens.name: agent-2
tokens.usage: Sea green. The agent in place 2.

tokens.name: agent-2-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-2's card.

tokens.name: agent-3
tokens.usage: Heather. The agent in place 3.

tokens.name: agent-3-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-3's card.

tokens.name: agent-4
tokens.usage: Olive. The agent in place 4.

tokens.name: agent-4-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-4's card.

tokens.name: agent-5
tokens.usage: Slate indigo. The agent in place 5.

tokens.name: agent-5-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-5's card.

tokens.name: agent-6
tokens.usage: Copper. The agent in place 6.

tokens.name: agent-6-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of agent-6's card.

tokens.name: risk-0
tokens.usage: Risk 0, normal: a hollow dot, and the word.

tokens.name: risk-1
tokens.usage: Risk 1, keep in mind: a hollow dot with a thicker ring, in ochre, and the word.

tokens.name: risk-2
tokens.usage: Risk 2, important: a filled clay dot, and the word.

tokens.name: risk-3
tokens.usage: Risk 3, serious: a filled crimson dot with a ring around it, and the word.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: Working: a filled sage dot that breathes slowly, and the word.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Idle, stopped, no data: a hollow dot, and the word.

tokens.name: state-frozen
tokens.usage: Paused or frozen: a hollow tide-blue dot with a thick ring, and the word.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting for your yes: clay, the colour that asks for you. A filled dot with a quicker pulse, the word, the held requests.

tokens.name: state-rewinding
tokens.usage: Rewinding: a filled plum dot that breathes, and the word.

tokens.name: state-sensor-down
tokens.usage: Sensor down: a filled crimson dot with a quick pulse, and the word. Shares risk 3's colour on purpose.

drawing.usage: The slabs of Inside the box (Layers). Top and side of each layer; the outline is ink at stroke-slab.
